title: Hidden Book Chapter
central_conflict: the old library book ended before its final chapter
decisive_choice: a penciled page number on a bookmark pointed to the repair desk
resolution: found the loose chapter and bound it into the book before the reading
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the old library book ended before its final chapter before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they checked the shelves, but the missing pages had no matching cover; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a penciled page number on a bookmark pointed to the repair desk; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they found the loose chapter and bound it into the book before the reading, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Floating Ball
central_conflict: a painted ball floated away just as the river began rising
decisive_choice: the shallower bend downstream was blocked by reeds that could hold it
resolution: waited at the bend and pulled the ball ashore with a safe rope
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a painted ball floated away just as the river began rising before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they reached with a long stick, but the fast current pushed it farther; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the shallower bend downstream was blocked by reeds that could hold it; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they waited at the bend and pulled the ball ashore with a safe rope, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Sunburned Flower
central_conflict: the newly planted flower curled its petals under the harsh sun
decisive_choice: a woven basket could shade the plant without stopping the breeze
resolution: raised the basket on stakes and helped the flower bloom again
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the newly planted flower curled its petals under the harsh sun before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they poured extra water, but its leaves continued drying in the heat; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a woven basket could shade the plant without stopping the breeze; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they raised the basket on stakes and helped the flower bloom again, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
